record.paper_title: Initial boundary value problem for Korteweg-de Vries equation: a review and open problems
record.context_brief: Low-regularity threshold for finite-interval KdV IBVP
record.original_question: For the same class of finite-interval Korteweg-de Vries IBVPs, let u solve u_t + u_x + u_xxx + u u_x = 0 for 0 < x < L and t > 0, with u(x,0) = phi(x), and with three endpoint boundary conditions B_i u = h_i(t), i = 1,2,3, where B_i u = sum_{j=0}^2 (a_ij partial_x^j u(0,t) + b_ij partial_x^j u(L,t)) for real constants a_ij and b_ij. Is this IBVP well-posed in H^s(0,L) for some regularity level s <= -1? The known local well-posedness range stated in the source is s >= 0, with an extension by the same approach to -1 < s <= 0, while the source conjectures ill-posedness for every s < -1.

Is the IBVP well-posed in the space Hs(0,L) for some s ≤ −1?
Theorem G ensures that the IBVP (4.18) is locally well-posed in the space Hs (0,L) for any s ≥ 0.
We conjecture that the IBVP (4.18) is ill-posed in the space Hs (0,L) for any s < −1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the Korteweg–de Vries initial–boundary value problem on a finite interval. Fix L>0 and real constants a_{ij}, b_{ij} for i=1,2,3 and j=0,1,2. For each i=1,2,3 define the boundary operator
   B_i u(t) = sum_{j=0}^{2} ( a_{ij} ∂_x^j u(0,t) + b_{ij} ∂_x^j u(L,t) ).
Given an initial datum φ on (0,L) and boundary data h_1, h_2, h_3 on (0,∞), seek u(x,t) satisfying
   u_t + u_x + u_{xxx} + u u_x = 0,   0 < x < L, t > 0,
   u(x,0) = φ(x),     0 < x < L,
   B_i u(t) = h_i(t), i = 1,2,3,   t > 0.
Assume that the triple (B_1, B_2, B_3) is admissible in the sense that the corresponding linear IBVP is well-posed (e.g., the linear problem is locally well-posed in H^s(0,L) for s ≥ 0, with an extension covering −1 < s ≤ 0 via the same approach).

Question: Does there exist some s ≤ −1 such that this nonlinear IBVP is locally well-posed in H^s(0,L) (with appropriately chosen compatible function spaces for the boundary data h_1, h_2, h_3)? In particular, is the IBVP ill-posed in H^s(0,L) for every s < −1?
artifact.status_search_result: Available literature establishes local well-posedness of the finite-interval KdV IBVP in H^s(0,L) for s ≥ 0 and, via refined techniques, for s > −1. No source was found that resolves well-posedness or ill-posedness at the threshold s ≤ −1; the question of whether the IBVP is ill-posed for every s < −1 appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: General Boundary Value Problems of the KdV Equation on a Bounded Domain
status_evidence.snippet: Local well-posedness in H^s(0,L) for s ≥ 0 under admissible boundary operators.
status_evidence.claim: Best published well-posedness threshold for the general finite-interval KdV IBVP is s > -1.

status_evidence.title: On the Propagation of Regularity of Solutions to the KdV Equation on the positive Half-line
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to study low regularity KdV IBVPs without reaching s ≤ -1 for finite-interval problems.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution at s ≤ -1 is reported in current low-regularity KdV IBVP literature.
